title: [Activity] Sentiment Analysis of Movie Reviews using RNN's and Keras

cues.en: This all will make a lot more sense with an example, and you'll see it's really nowhere near as hard as it sounds when you're using Keras.
cues.zh: 看範例會更容易理解，而且你會發現，使用 Keras，真的遠沒有聽起來那麼難。

cues.en: I used to work at IMDb, so I can't resist using a movie related example so let's dive into that next, and see RNN's Recurrent Neural Networks in action.
cues.zh: 我以前在 IMDb 工作，忍不住要用電影相關範例，接著看看循環神經網路 RNN 實際運作。

cues.en: So let's have some fun with recurrent neural networks.
cues.zh: 來玩玩循環神經網路。

cues.en: As usual, open up Anaconda Navigator and make sure you're in the RecSys environment, and start up Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，開啟 Anaconda Navigator，確認在 RecSys 環境，再啟動 Jupyter Notebook。

cues.en: Upload the Keras-RNN notebook file, from the course materials in the DeepLearningIntro folder,
cues.zh: 上傳課程教材 DeepLearningIntro 資料夾中的 Keras-RNN Notebook，

cues.en: and click on it to open it up once it is imported.
cues.zh: 匯入後點選開啟。

cues.en: Although RNN's sounded pretty scary in the slides, using them in Keras is actually fairly straightforward.
cues.zh: 雖然投影片裡 RNN 聽起來很可怕，Keras 用起來其實相當直接。

cues.en: It's still tricky to tune things properly, but assuming you have some sort of a template of a similar problem to work from, it's quite easy in practice.
cues.zh: 正確調整仍然棘手，但假設有類似問題的範本可參考，實務上就相當容易。

cues.en: What we'll do here is try to do sentiment analysis.
cues.zh: 這裡試著做情緒分析。

cues.en: This is going to be an example of a sequence to vector RNN problem, where we're taking the sequence of words in a user-written movie review, and we try to output a vector,
cues.zh: 這是序列到向量的 RNN 問題：接受使用者撰寫影評中的詞語序列，試著輸出一個向量，

cues.en: that's just a single binary value, of whether or not that user liked the movie or not.
cues.zh: 其實只是單一二元值，表示使用者喜不喜歡電影。

cues.en: That is, whether they gave it a positive rating.
cues.zh: 也就是，是否給正面評價。

cues.en: This is an example of doing sentiment classification using real user review data from IMDb.
cues.zh: 這是使用 IMDb 真實使用者評論，做情緒分類的範例。

cues.en: And since I used to run IMDb's engineering department, this is a little bit too tempting for me to do as an example here.
cues.zh: 由於以前負責 IMDb 工程部門，我實在忍不住把它拿來當例子。

cues.en: Just to give credit where credit is due, this is drawing heavily upon one of the examples that ships with Keras, the IMDb LSTM sample.
cues.zh: 先註明來源，這大量參考 Keras 附帶的 IMDb LSTM 範例。

cues.en: I've embellished on it a little bit here, but the idea is theirs.
cues.zh: 我稍微加了些內容，但想法是他們的。

cues.en: And it does warm my heart that they include the IMDB dataset as part of Keras, free to experiment with.
cues.zh: Keras 包含 IMDb 資料集，可免費實驗，也讓我很開心。

cues.en: Anyhow, this is another example of how we're going to use LSTM cells, or long short-term memory cells.
cues.zh: 總之，這是另一個使用 LSTM，也就是長短期記憶單元的例子。

cues.en: When you're dealing with textual data, which is sequences of words in a sentence, it doesn't necessarily matter where in the sentence that word appeared.
cues.zh: 處理文字資料，也就是句子中的詞語序列，詞出現在句中哪裡，不一定重要。

cues.en: You don't want words towards the end of the sentence counting more toward your classification than words that are at the beginning of the sentence.
cues.zh: 不希望句尾的詞，比句首更影響分類。

cues.en: In fact, often, it's the other way around.
cues.zh: 事實上，通常正好相反。

cues.en: So we're going to use an LSTM cell to try to counteract that effect that you see in normal RNNs, where data becomes diluted over time, or as the sequence of words progresses, in this example.
cues.zh: 因此，使用 LSTM，試著對抗一般 RNN 隨時間稀釋資料的效果，這裡就是隨詞語序列推進而稀釋。

cues.en: Let's just dive in and see how it works.
cues.zh: 直接看看如何運作。

cues.en: We'll start by importing all the stuff that we need from Keras.
cues.zh: 先從 Keras 匯入需要的所有東西。

cues.en: We're importing sequence, a pre-processing module of the sequential model, so we can embed those different layers together.
cues.zh: 匯入前處理模組 sequence，以及 Sequential 模型，讓不同層能組合起來。

cues.en: We're going to introduce a new embedding layer as part of our RNN, in addition to the dense layer that we had before.
cues.zh: 除了先前的 Dense，RNN 會新增 Embedding 嵌入層。

cues.en: We'll import the LSTM module.
cues.zh: 匯入 LSTM 模組。

cues.en: And finally we'll import the IMDb dataset.
cues.zh: 最後，匯入 IMDb 資料集。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and shift-enter to do all of that and get Keras initialized.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter 完成匯入、初始化 Keras。

cues.en: Next, we can import our training and testing data.
cues.zh: 接著，匯入訓練與測試資料。

cues.en: Like I said, Keras has a handy IMDb dataset pre-installed.
cues.zh: 如前所說，Keras 預先附有方便的 IMDb 資料集。

cues.en: Oddly, it has 5,000 training reviews and 25,000 testing reviews, which seems backwards to me, but it is what it is.
cues.zh: 奇怪的是，有 5000 筆訓練評論，以及 25,000 筆測試評論，我覺得好像反過來了，但資料就是如此。

cues.en: The one parameter you're seeing here for num_words indicates how many unique words that you want to load into your training and testing dataset.
cues.zh: 這裡的 num_words 參數，指定要在訓練與測試資料中載入多少個不同詞。

cues.en: So by saying num_words equals 20,000, that means that I'm going to limit my data to the 20,000 most popular words in the dataset.
cues.zh: num_words=20000，表示把資料限制在資料集中最常見的 20,000 個詞。

cues.en: If someone uses some really obscure word, it's not going to show up in our input data.
cues.zh: 如果有人用非常冷僻的詞，就不會出現在輸入資料。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and load that up.
cues.zh: 載入它。

cues.en: And since it does have to do some thinking, it doesn't come back instantly, but it's pretty quick.
cues.zh: 它需要做一些處理，不會立刻回來，但相當快。

cues.en: Let's take a peek at what this data looks like.
cues.zh: 看看資料長什麼樣子。

cues.en: So let's take a look at the first instance of training data here.
cues.zh: 先看第一筆訓練資料。

cues.en: It's just a bunch of numbers!
cues.zh: 只是一堆數字。

cues.en: It doesn't look like a movie review to me.
cues.zh: 看起來不像影評。

cues.en: Well, you can be very thankful to the folks behind Keras for doing this for you.
cues.zh: 你應該很感謝 Keras 團隊，已替你做好這件事。

cues.en: When you're doing machine learning in general, models don't work with words, they work with numbers.
cues.zh: 一般機器學習模型，不處理詞，而是數字。

cues.en: So we need to convert these words to numbers somehow as a first step.
cues.zh: 因此，第一步要用某種方法，把詞轉成數字。

cues.en: Keras has done all this pre-processing for you already.
cues.zh: Keras 已替你完成所有前處理。

cues.en: So the number one might correspond to the word "the".
cues.zh: 所以，數字一可能對應 the。

cues.en: I actually have no idea what it corresponds to, but they've encoded each unique word between 0 and 20,000, because we said we wanted the 20,000 most popular words, to numbers.
cues.zh: 其實我不知道對應什麼，但我們要求最常見的 20,000 個詞，所以它把不同詞，編碼成零到 20,000 的數字。

cues.en: So it's kind of a bummer that we can't actually read these reviews and get an intuitive meaning of what these reviews are saying, but it saves us a whole lot of work.
cues.zh: 有點可惜，無法直接讀評論、直覺理解內容，但省下大量工作。

cues.en: Often, a lot of the work in machine learning is not so much building your models and tuning them, it's just processing and massaging your input data, and making sure that your input data looks good to go.
cues.zh: 機器學習很多工作，往往不是建立、調整模型，而是處理、整理輸入資料，確保準備就緒。

cues.en: So even though this doesn't look like a movie review, it is a movie review.
cues.zh: 所以，雖然看起來不像影評，但它確實是。

cues.en: They've just replaced all of the words with unique numbers that represent each word.
cues.zh: 只是把所有詞，換成代表各詞的唯一數字。

cues.en: We can also take a look at the training label data.
cues.zh: 也能查看訓練標籤。

cues.en: So the classification of this particular review was one, which just means that they liked it.
cues.zh: 這篇評論的分類是一，表示喜歡。

cues.en: So the only classifications are zero and one, which correspond to a negative or a positive sentiment for that review.
cues.zh: 因此，分類只有零與一，對應負面或正面情緒。

cues.en: Now we just have to go ahead and set things up for our network.
cues.zh: 現在，只要為網路設定資料。

cues.en: Let's start by creating some vectors for input here.
cues.zh: 先建立輸入向量。

cues.en: Let's break out our training and test data here.
cues.zh: 分開處理訓練與測試資料。

cues.en: We're going to call sequence.pad_sequences, just to make sure that everything has a limit on them to 80 words.
cues.zh: 呼叫 sequence.pad_sequences，確保全部限制為 80 個詞。

cues.en: The reason we're doing this is because, like we said, RNNs can blow up very quickly.
cues.zh: 原因是，如前所說，RNN 很容易快速膨脹。

cues.en: You have to back propagate through time.
cues.zh: 必須沿時間反向傳播。

cues.en: So we want to have an upper bound on how many time steps we need to back propagate to.
cues.zh: 因此，希望為需要回溯的時間步數，設上限。

cues.en: By saying maxlen equals 80, that means we're only going to look at the first 80 words in each review, and limit our analysis to that.
cues.zh: maxlen=80，表示每篇評論只看前 80 個詞，分析僅限於此。

cues.en: So that is a way of truncating our backpropagation through time.
cues.zh: 這是截斷隨時間反向傳播的方法。

cues.en: It's sort of a low tech way of doing it, but it's effective.
cues.zh: 雖然很簡單，但有效。

cues.en: Otherwise, we would be running this thing for days.
cues.zh: 否則，可能得跑好幾天。

cues.en: The only point here is to trim all of these reviews in both the training and the test dataset to their first 80 words, which again have been converted to numbers for us already.
cues.zh: 重點只是，把訓練集與測試集中的評論，都截成前 80 個詞，而且已經替我們轉成數字。

cues.en: Shift enter to run that as well.
cues.zh: 也按 Shift+Enter 執行。

cues.en: Let's build up the model itself.
cues.zh: 建立模型本身。

cues.en: For such a complicated neural network, I think it's pretty remarkable how few lines of code are going on here.
cues.zh: 神經網路這麼複雜，卻只需要這麼少程式碼，我覺得相當驚人。

cues.en: We'll start by creating a sequential model, meaning that we can just build up the topology of our network one step at a time here.
cues.zh: 先建立 Sequential 模型，表示能一步一步建立網路拓樸。

cues.en: We'll start with some additional pre-processing.
cues.zh: 先做額外前處理。

cues.en: We're using what's called an embedding layer here.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 Embedding 嵌入層。

cues.en: All that does is convert our input data of words up to the first 80 words in a given review into dense vectors of some fixed size.
cues.zh: 只是把輸入的詞資料，也就是某篇評論最多前 80 個詞，轉成固定大小的稠密向量。

cues.en: So it's going to create a dense vector of a fixed size of 20,000 words, and then funnel that into 128 hidden neurons inside my neural network.
cues.zh: 因此，建立固定大小、20,000 個詞的稠密向量，再送入網路的 128 個隱藏神經元。

cues.en: That's all the embedding layer is doing.
cues.zh: Embedding 層只做這件事。

cues.en: It's just taking that input textual data that's been encoded, and converting that into a format that's suitable for input into my neural network.
cues.zh: 就是把已編碼的文字輸入，轉成適合神經網路的格式。

cues.en: Then, with a single line of code, we build our recurrent neural network.
cues.zh: 接著，只用一行程式碼，建立循環神經網路。

cues.en: So we just say, "add an LSTM."
cues.zh: 只要說：「加入 LSTM。」

cues.en: Let's go through the properties here.
cues.zh: 看看屬性。

cues.en: We're asking for 128 recurrent neurons in that LSTM layer.
cues.zh: 要求 LSTM 層有 128 個循環神經元。

cues.en: We can also specify dropout terms just in that same command here.
cues.zh: 同一個命令中，也能指定 Dropout 參數。

cues.en: So we're asking for a dropout of 20%.
cues.zh: 這裡要求 20% Dropout。

cues.en: And that's all there is to it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: That one line of code sets up our LSTM neural network with 128 recurrent neurons and adds dropout phases of 20%, all in one step.
cues.zh: 一行程式碼，一次設定 128 個循環神經元的 LSTM，並加入 20% Dropout 階段。

cues.en: Finally, we need to boil that down to a single output neuron with a sigmoid activation function, because we're dealing with a binary classification problem, and that's it.
cues.zh: 最後，濃縮到單一輸出神經元，使用 Sigmoid，因為是二元分類問題，就完成。

cues.en: Run this block to set up our model.
cues.zh: 執行區塊，設定模型。

cues.en: So we've defined the topology of our network with just four lines of code, even though it's a very complicated recurrent neural network, using LSTM cells and dropout phases.
cues.zh: 因此，即使是使用 LSTM 與 Dropout 的複雜 RNN，也只用四行程式碼，就定義拓樸。

cues.en: But Keras makes that all very easy to do.
cues.zh: Keras 讓一切很容易。

cues.en: We then need to tell Keras how to optimize this neural network and how to train it.
cues.zh: 接著，告訴 Keras 如何最佳化與訓練。

cues.en: So we will use binary cross-entropy, because this is ultimately a binary classification problem, "did the movie like this movie or not?"
cues.zh: 使用 binary_crossentropy，因為最後是二元分類：「使用者喜不喜歡這部電影？」

cues.en: We'll use the Adam optimizer this time, because that's the best of both worlds for optimizers.
cues.zh: 這次用 Adam，因為結合最佳化器的兩種優點。

cues.en: And then we can kick it off.
cues.zh: 接著能開始。

cues.en: Hit shift-enter to compile our model.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter，編譯模型。

cues.en: And at this point, you're ready to actually train your neural network.
cues.zh: 現在準備好真正訓練神經網路。

cues.en: Let's just walk through what's going on here.
cues.zh: 看看這裡發生什麼事。

cues.en: It's very similar to the previous examples.
cues.zh: 與前面範例非常相似。

cues.en: In this case, we're going to use batch sizes of 32 reviews at once.
cues.zh: 每批同時使用 32 篇評論。

cues.en: We're going to run it over 15 training steps, or epochs, set a verbosity layer that's compatible with Jupyter Notebooks, and provide the validation data for its use as well.
cues.zh: 執行 15 個訓練步驟或週期，verbose 設為相容 Jupyter Notebook 的層級，也提供驗證資料。

cues.en: Now, again, I'm not going to actually run this right now, because it will take about an hour.
cues.zh: 同樣，現在不會真的執行，因為大約需要一小時。

cues.en: Like I said, RNNs are hard, they take a lot of computing resources.
cues.zh: 如前所說，RNN 困難，耗費很多運算資源。

cues.en: And since all I'm doing is running this on my single CPU, I don't even have things configured to use my GPU, or let alone a cluster of computers, this takes a long time.
cues.zh: 我只在單一 CPU 執行，甚至沒設定 GPU，更不用說電腦叢集，因此很耗時。

cues.en: But I did run it earlier, and you can see the results here.
cues.zh: 但之前已經執行過，這裡能看到結果。

cues.en: So over 15 epochs, you can see that the accuracy that it was measuring on the training data was beginning to converge.
cues.zh: 15 個訓練週期中，可以看到，訓練資料的準確率，開始收斂。

cues.en: Seems like after about 13 steps it was getting about as good as it was going to get.
cues.zh: 大約 13 步後，似乎已經接近最佳。

cues.en: And then furthermore, we can actually evaluate that model, given the testing dataset.
cues.zh: 另外，也能用測試資料集評估模型。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and call evaluate on that with our test data.
cues.zh: 對測試資料，呼叫 evaluate。

cues.en: Again, using 32 batches.
cues.zh: 同樣使用 32 個批次。

cues.en: And if we were to run that, we would see that we end up with an accuracy of 81% on our model here.
cues.zh: 執行的話，會看到模型最後準確率是 81%。

cues.en: It doesn't sound that impressive, but when you consider that all we're doing is looking at the first 80 words of each review and trying to figure out just based on that beginning
cues.zh: 聽起來沒那麼厲害，但考慮到只看每篇評論前 80 個詞，光根據開頭，判斷

cues.en: whether or not a user liked the movie or not, that's not too bad.
cues.zh: 使用者喜不喜歡電影，其實不差。

cues.en: But, step back and think about what we just made here.
cues.zh: 但退一步，想想剛才做了什麼。

cues.en: We've made a neural network that can essentially read English language reviews and determine some sort of meaning behind them.
cues.zh: 建立了一個基本上能閱讀英文評論，並判斷某種含義的神經網路。

cues.en: In this case, we've trained it how to take a sequence of words at the beginning of a movie review that some human wrote, and classify that as a positive review or a negative review.
cues.zh: 這裡，訓練它接受人類影評開頭的一串詞，再分類為正評或負評。

cues.en: So in a very real sense, at a very basic level, we've taught our computer how to read.
cues.zh: 因此，從非常基本、但真實的意義來說，教會了電腦閱讀。

cues.en: How cool is that?
cues.zh: 多酷。

cues.en: And the amount of code that we wrote to do that was minimal.
cues.zh: 而程式碼極少。

cues.en: It's kind of mind-blowing.
cues.zh: 有點令人難以置信。

cues.en: It's really just a matter of knowing what technique to use to build your neural network, providing the appropriate training data, and then your neural network does the rest.
cues.zh: 其實只是知道該用哪種技術建立神經網路，提供適當訓練資料，其餘由神經網路完成。

cues.en: It's really kind of spooky when you step back and think about it.
cues.zh: 退一步想，真的有點不可思議。

cues.en: This is a great example of how powerful Keras can be, and a great example of an application of a recurrent neural network, not using the typical example of stock trading data or something like that.
cues.zh: 這是 Keras 強大能力的好例子，也是 RNN 應用的好例子，不用典型股票交易資料之類的範例。

cues.en: Instead we've used an RNN for sentiment analysis, where we took a sequence of words and used that to create a binary classification of a sentiment based on that sequence.
cues.zh: 我們改用 RNN 做情緒分析，接受詞語序列，根據序列，產生情緒的二元分類。

cues.en: RNN's are very powerful tools for a wide variety of problems, and the Keras API makes them easy and fun to work with.
cues.zh: RNN 對各式問題都非常強大，Keras API 讓它容易又有趣。

cues.en: So, that was a rather long diversion into the basics of deep learning, but I had to get you to the point of understanding recurrent neural networks before we start
cues.zh: 我們繞了一大段路，介紹深度學習基礎，但在開始

cues.en: talking about applying deep learning to recommender systems.
cues.zh: 把深度學習應用到推薦系統前，必須先讓你理解 RNN。

cues.en: As it turns out, deep learning is especially suitable to predicting sequences of events, like which videos you're likely to watch next, so this has applications in recommender systems
cues.zh: 深度學習特別適合預測事件序列，例如接下來可能看哪些影片，因此能用在

cues.en: that deal with situations where the order of events matters.
cues.zh: 事件順序很重要的推薦系統情況。

cues.en: So, RNN's play a big role in the current research toward applying deep learning to recommender systems.
cues.zh: 所以，RNN 在目前深度學習推薦系統的研究中，有重要地位。

cues.en: But, there are much simpler neural networks that can be used to recommend items too, so we don't have to jump straight to the hard stuff.
cues.zh: 但更簡單的神經網路，也能推薦項目，不必直接跳到困難的部分。

cues.en: Stick with me, we're going to get back to recommender systems now, and how to apply what you've just learned about deep learning to them.
cues.zh: 繼續跟著我，現在回到推薦系統，看看如何應用剛學過的深度學習。

cues.en: And if you do want to keep learning more about deep learning in general, you can find the rest of my free course on deep learning on YouTube, just search for Sundog Education and you'll find it.
cues.zh: 如果想繼續學更多一般深度學習，YouTube 上有我的免費課程其餘部分，搜尋 Sundog Education 就能找到。
